build_pptx_from_directory: build a PPTX file from an unpacked directory with auto-repair validation enabled
build_docx_from_directory: build a DOCX file from an unpacked directory with schema and redlining validation against an original file
build_xlsx_from_directory: build an XLSX file from an unpacked directory with condensed XML formatting
test_pack_validation: test the pack function with validation disabled to skip schema checks
review_pack_condense: review the pack function to condense XML whitespace and comments before zipping
